feature_notes: Fixes opening valid stream-generated ZIP and ZIP64 workbooks: data descriptors no longer trigger a false uncompressed-size-limit error. Removes fixed default compressed archive, aggregate uncompressed and worksheet byte caps, allowing legitimate large files without archive-size tuning. Explicit finite caps remain supported and report actual/configured sizes. Streaming buffers, managed memory and metadata controls remain independent. Regression coverage verifies streamed ZIP/ZIP64 values beyond incorrect worksheet dimension metadata and explicit finite cap acceptance/rejection. Python read_only users with incorrect A1:A1 source dimensions should call reset_dimensions() before iteration; a forced dimension scan is optional and costs another pass. The reported NYC million-row workbook has not been measured locally. M4/M5/performance release plans move to Alpha 7/8/9; these milestones are not declared complete.
